## A. API Purpose
Authenticates a staff user for the mobile app. Web equivalent: `ecsystem/src/pages/login.vue` → `POST /auth/login`.

**When to call:** App launch or session expiry before any Admin API.

## B. Response Structure
**Request:** JSON `{ "email", "password" }` — `email` may be email or phone (`AuthController`).

**Success 200:** `{ "user": UserResource::forSession, "token": "<sanctum-plain-text>" }` — token is top-level string.

**User fields (session):** `id`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `can_login`, `roles[]`, `centers[]` (`id`, `title`), `permissions` (when included), `is_parent_user`, etc.

**Failure 422:** `errors.email` — invalid credentials.

## C. Mobile UI Mapping
| Field | Mobile use |
|---|---|
| `token` | Store securely; attach as Bearer |
| `user.centers[0].id` | Default `center_id` for lists |
| `user.name`, `picture` | Profile header |
| `permissions` / roles | Feature flags & menu visibility (CASL on web) |

## D. Data Handling
Postman test script saves `token` and first `center_id` to collection + environment. Use `{{login_email}}` / `{{login_password}}` variables only — never embed in other requests.

## E. Dependencies & Navigation
No prior API. All Admin requests depend on this.

## F. Verified Example
Structure verified; do not commit real tokens. Success shape: `{ "user": { "id": 0, "centers": [{ "id": 1, "title": "…" }] }, "token": "1|…" }`.

request.description:
## A. API Purpose
Loads the main admin analytics dashboard (`dashboard/analytics`, route `dashboards-analytics`). Called once on page load via `statisticsApi.fetchAdminDshboard({ log_type })` with `center_id` from session.

**Also satisfies:** daily attendance chart, monthly attendance chart, daily/monthly *session message* charts, disability bar chart, recent-goals-by-category chart — all from this single response (no separate attendance endpoints on the dashboard).

## B. Response Structure
**Top-level wrapper:** `{ "data": ..., "success": true, "message": null }` via `apiResponse()` unless noted.

`data` object fields (verified LIVE + `StatisticsController@admin_dashboard`):

| JSON path | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `data.cases_count` | integer | Total cases in center |
| `data.teachers_count` | integer | Staff with teacher role in center |
| `data.specialists_count` | integer | Staff with specialist role in center |
| `data.recent_assessments` | integer | Count of assessment evaluations updated in last month (not a list) |
| `data.recent_goals_count` | integer | Count of goals with evaluations updated in last month (not a list) |
| `data.recent_goals` | array | `{ category, count }` grouped goal categories (last month activity) |
| `data.disabilities` | array | `{ id, name, count }` cases per disability type |
| `data.attendance_daily` | array | **Daily attendance chart** — `{ year, month, day, count }` present attendances (`status=1`), last ~1 month |
| `data.attendance_monthly` | array | **Monthly attendance chart** — `{ year, month, count }`, last 12 months |
| `data.goals_daily` | array | Session messages per day (14 days) — `{ year, month, day, count }` |
| `data.goals_monthly` | array | Session messages per month (12 months) — `{ year, month, count }` |
| `data.recent_logs` | array | Initial log bar chart (same shape as log statistics): `{ id, name, count }` staff activity |

Query: `center_id` (required for correct center), `log_type` (optional, default `all`) — used only for embedded `recent_logs` slice; changing log filter on web calls **Log statistics** instead.

## C. Mobile UI Mapping
| Response path | Mobile UI | Display |
|---|---|---|
| `cases_count` | Stat card | Large number + "total cases" label |
| `teachers_count` | Stat card | Teachers count |
| `specialists_count` | Stat card | Specialists count |
| `recent_assessments` | Stat card | Label like assessments (last month count) — **number only**, not navigable list in web |
| `recent_goals_count` | Stat card | Goals activity count (last month) |
| `recent_goals[]` | Bar chart | X: `category` (translate via i18n `statistics.{category}`), Y: `count` |
| `disabilities[]` | Bar chart | X: `name`, Y: `count` |
| `attendance_daily` / `attendance_monthly` | Attendance chart tabs | Daily tab: label `day + month`, value `count`. Monthly tab: `month + year`, value `count`. See `chartsTabs.vue` with `title="attendance"` |
| `goals_daily` / `goals_monthly` | Session activity chart | Same tab pattern, `title="daily_goals"` |
| Quick action cards | Buttons | Navigate to cases add/list/assessments — see Dashboard folder description |

Web does **not** navigate when tapping stat cards.

## D. Data Handling
- Treat missing `statistics` as loading until 200.
- Empty arrays for charts → show empty chart state, not an error.
- `recent_assessments` / `recent_goals_count` are **scalar counts**, not "recent items" lists.
- Attendance daily/monthly are **separate arrays** in one payload; mobile may split into two chart components without a second HTTP call.

## E. Dependencies & Navigation
Call **after Login** (needs `token`, `center_id`). Optional: **Log activity types** before showing log filter if user has `access_logs`.

### Dashboard quick actions (navigation only — no API)

| UI label (web i18n) | Arabic (typical) | Web route | Vue route name | API before navigate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Register Case | تسجيل حالة | `/cases/add` | `cases-add` | None — empty form; Registration APIs load dropdowns on page |
| List Cases | استعراض حالات | `/cases/list` | `cases-list` | None — list loads via **List cases** |
| Comprehensive Assessment | عمل تقييم شامل | `/cases/assessments` | `cases-assessments` | None — pick case on page |

Source: `ecsystem/src/pages/dashboards/analytics.vue` (`router.push`).

## F. Verified Example
Sanitized structure (counts illustrative only):
```json
{
  "data": {
    "cases_count": 0,
    "teachers_count": 0,
    "specialists_count": 0,
    "recent_assessments": 0,
    "recent_goals_count": 0,
    "attendance_daily": [{ "year": 2026, "month": 3, "day": 1, "count": 0 }],
    "attendance_monthly": [{ "year": 2026, "month": 3, "count": 0 }],
    "recent_goals": [{ "category": "educational", "count": 0 }],
    "disabilities": [{ "id": 1, "name": "…", "count": 0 }],
    "goals_daily": [],
    "goals_monthly": [],
    "recent_logs": [{ "id": 1, "name": "Staff", "count": 0 }]
  },
  "success": true,
  "message": null
}
```
Verified against LIVE `GET /statistics/admin_dashboard`.

| Staff attendance page | `access_employees-attendance` | `EmployeeAttendanceController` — center only |
| Leaves page | `access_users` list; `edit_users` for add/review/delete UI | `EmployeeLeaveController` — center membership; **no `edit_users` check in controller** |

**Package note:** Centers with `package_id` 2 or 3 hide staff attendance menu (`buildAppAndPages`).

Center online meeting rooms (Jitsi URL in `meeting_url`). API prefix `/api/meeting-rooms`. Frontend list: `https://platform.athrplatform.com/meeting-rooms/list`.

### Mobile vs web roles (backend-enforced)

| Role | List (`GET /`) | Show | Join/leave attendance | Redeem link | Create/edit/delete | Invitation link | Attendance report | Start WhatsApp messages |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Parent** (no `edit_meetings`) | Public + assigned-parent rooms only; **no** link-invite rows | If `MeetingRoomAccess::userCanAccess` | Yes, if can access room | Yes (parent grant) | **403** | **403** | **403** | Only if can access room |
| **Staff** (`show_meetings` / `access_meetings`) | Own rooms + administrative type | Per access rules | Yes | Staff bypass for link rooms | **403** without `edit_meetings` | **403** | **403** | If can access |

**Disabled rooms:** soft-deleted (`deleted_at`). Parents never see trashed rows. Staff with `edit_meetings`/`admin_meetings` may list/show via `status=all` or `inactive`.
